result.summary: The image shows a four-way intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of signalization and narrow walkways adjacent to traffic lanes create a moderately risky environment.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: Lack of visible traffic signals or stop signs for the primary travel lanes at a multi-leg intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are present but appear worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or a raised intersection to slow vehicle speeds through the crossing area.

result.summary: A residential street with a paved sidewalk directly adjacent to the curb. On-street parallel parking is present, with a large SUV partially obstructing the view of the walkway and potential crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The parked SUV in the foreground blocks the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians who might be stepping off the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the travel/parking lane with no physical buffer or planting strip.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the driveway/access point to improve sightlines for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to narrow the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to access points, improving visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks and a mature tree canopy providing shade. While the narrow street width likely moderates traffic speeds, the presence of parked cars on both sides creates visual obstructions for pedestrians, and there are no marked crossings or traffic calming features visible.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the block

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bags and debris are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk in the mid-ground

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a vehicle parked directly on the sidewalk, completely blocking the path and forcing pedestrians into the roadway. Additionally, large tree roots have caused significant upheaval of the pavement, creating a trip hazard and further reducing accessibility.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked entirely on the sidewalk, blocking the pedestrian path and forcing people into the street.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Tree roots are lifting the sidewalk slabs, creating a significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the tree base

interventions.title: Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level the sidewalk around the tree using flexible or permeable materials that accommodate root growth without cracking pavement.
